shortDescription: Our uniquely engineered induction cooktops offer exceptional power, precision, and responsiveness for fast, efficient heating and even cooking. Using electromagnetic energy to directly heat your cookware—and only your cookware—induction is 5-10% more energy-efficient than conventional electric cooktops and about 3 times more efficient than gas.

features.text: Plus, the cooktop surface remains cool, making it safer to operate and easier to clean.

Four induction cooktop elements of varying sizes and power levels provide all the power and precision you need. Induction works with a wide range of cookware, from cast iron to stainless steel—if a magnet sticks to the bottom of the pan, it’s good to go.
UltraHeat™ 4.3kW Element for Quick Boil or True Simmer
With 4,300 watts of power, our UltraHeat™ element is powerful enough to rapidly boil water and flexible enough to turn down to a true simmer, perfect for soups and sauces.
Need extra cooking power? Activate Boost mode to temporarily maximize an element's power output. Ideal for quickly boiling large pots of water or heating large quantities of food.

Enjoy the professional look and feel of a ceramic induction cooktop that elevates any kitchen. Featuring SmoothTouch® Glass Controls and smooth surface that easily wipes clean, this cooktop delivers seamless, built-in style and premium form and function to your countertop.
Not only do the intuitive SmoothTouch® glass controls look sleek, but they provide effortless operation with just a touch of your finger.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App

The ThinQ® app offers control and convenience to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home. Sync the cooktop and a smart LG hood or over-the-range microwave to auto-activate the fan and light when the cooktop is in use. Plus, access remote monitoring, Smart Diagnosis, customer support, and more. ThinQ UP™ appliances receive software updates for new features and enhancements.
Safer, Easy to Clean, and Detects Your Cookware

Because induction uses electromagnetic energy to heat only your induction-compatible cookware, and not the cooktop itself, fire hazards and risk of burns are reduced for a safer experience. And since the cooktop remains relatively cool, drips and splatters won’t burn onto the surface, allowing for easier cleanup than radiant electric and gas cooktops.

How well your cookware heats on an induction element depends on several factors such as the cookware's size, material, and even the shape of its base. Our cooktop is equipped with an Energy Efficiency Indicator that helps you maximize the power and energy efficiency of each element by rating your cookware’s compatibility on a scale of 0 to 10. The higher the number, the better the compatibility of the cookware and the element.
Get the Perfect Simmer with Just a Tap
Thanks to a dedicated Simmer key on the control panel, you can quickly and easily achieve the perfect simmer. Great for sauces, stews and more.
